Game Overview

At its heart, Sumo.io is a sports game about become a sumo champion in Sumo.io. Feast on sushi to grow, strategize to outmaneuver rivals, and push them into the abyss in this thrilling arena. Balance size and cunning to dominate, using simple yet addictive mechanics. Dodge, surprise, and conquer as you aim to be the last sumo standing.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Sumo.io is easy to pick up. Become a sumo champion in Sumo.io!
